canonical_rule: First listed CMUdict pronunciation; per-word frozen local en-us eSpeak only for OOV words
variant_rule: Only explicit same-word, same-length, stress-preserving AH0/IH0 alternatives at exactly one position; all accepted variants of a word must differ at that same position
unsupported_variant_policy: Mark whole word block non-diagnostic; do not insert unsupported paths or label them automatically correct
stress_projection: Preserve CMU stress in provenance; strip stress for frozen 39-phone acoustic model
path_weights: Uniform across deduplicated local accepted alternatives; their independent cross-word product is normalized
evaluation: All-optimal unit edit alignment; stable binary-error and exact-event masks are distinct; ambiguous blocks are excluded from diagnosis
